meta.title: Quantity counter offer for partial awarding per line item

plan.title: Quantity Counter Offer for Partial Award

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ QCS containing a vendor bid.

args.goal: On the RFQ QCS, click Counter Offer beneath the vendor's name, select the Quantity field, enter a reduced quantity, click Send Counter Offer, and stop when the screen shows the success tooltip, Counter Offer Requested above the vendor name, and the quantity cell highlighted with the original and counter-offer quantities.

steps.note: Perform and verify the quantity-specific counter-offer flow and its visual result.
Assert that the vendor is visibly marked as having a requested counter offer.
Assert that the QCS records the counter offer as initiated for the vendor.
